Elden Ring poison and scarlet rot status effects

Game: Elden Ring.

In Elden Ring, poison and scarlet rot are status effects that cause damage over time. Poison buildup increases while standing in a poison swamp. Use an appropriate bolus to cure buildup when safe, or wait away from the hazard for the buildup meter to drop. This base-game article describes status ailments and does not explain equipment load, heavy rolling, weapon upgrades or early Samurai stat allocation.
